summary: Make Copilot Builder a coherent internal world, with a briefing artifact and a clear RAPP/1 boundary.
tradeoffs: Keep one visible root bot and one Librarian; Builder is an internal world, not another bot.
The briefing is canonical inert text. No host source file, native profile, model configuration or external service is changed.

scope.name: Copilot Builder
scope.description: An internal workspace world for the headless Copilot bridge.

actions.name: Builder brief
actions.content: Build outcomes from reviewed intent. Use exact canonical context, a pinned Copilot SDK model, and verified root-scoped capabilities. No source or native-store writes are authorized.
